label: Shear strain in a joint
subgoals: Multiply the CTE mismatch by the temperature swing
Multiply by the distance from the neutral point

label: Coffin-Manson scaling
subgoals: Take the ratio of the two strains
Raise it to the fatigue exponent
Scale the known lifetime by the result

subgoals: Express life as height over DNP raised to the exponent
Scale the known life to the new DNP
Name the other levers that lower strain
